description:
Cast a copy of Lightning Bolt from exile by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Emeritus of Conflict.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}
Repeat.
